name: M7.CanonicalClasses.normalized_separated
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N), M7.CanonicalClasses.Normalized bases → M7.OrbitResidual.Separated bases
context:
theorem M7.CanonicalClasses.orbit_membership : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c y : M7.Action.Recipe N, y ∈ M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c ↔ M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical y = M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical c := by
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c y : M7.Action.Recipe N, y ∈ M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c ↔ M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical y = M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical c
  intro N _ c y
  classical
  simp only [M7.ActualOrbit.orbit, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact (M7.CanonicalOuter.orbit_complete N c y).trans eq_comm
guidance:
Discharge original M7 emitted-orbit separation using the now accepted actual canonical form, not a supplied transversal. CanonicalOuter.realizer_correct and canonical_invariant prove idempotence. ActualOrbit.orbit is univ.image(actual action); accepted CanonicalOuter.orbit_complete proves membership iff equality of canonical forms (careful equality orientation). If an image belongs to two orbits, both canonical forms are equal; Normalized bases rewrites each to the literal stored value, contradicting distinctness. covered is actual biUnion. coverage_iff and fresh_representative identify exactly the not-yet-emitted class. Only OrbitResidual semantic definitions are imported; no pending residual theorem is used. All action laws include empty blocks, N=1 and nonfaithful actions; final original input constraints are supplied later. Return tactic lines only.
import M7CanonicalOuterAccepted
import M7OrbitResidual

namespace M7.CanonicalClasses
def Normalized {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ bases, M7.CanonicalOuter.canonical c = c
end M7.CanonicalClasses
